DBC Second Saturday Coffee Social and Ride

Dallas, TX · Social

Beginner friendly

DBC Second Saturday Coffee Social and Ride is a social group ride in Dallas, TX. It rolls second Saturday of the month at 10:30 am from Rotates monthly; RSVP on the Dallas Bicycle Coalition's Action Network page for the spot. About 10 miles, about 10 mph, social.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10 mph: you can talk the whole way.
Check
Look at @dallasbicyclecoalition the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the DBC Second Saturday Coffee Social and Ride group ride

The Dallas Bicycle Coalition's monthly coffee social and bike ride. Coffee and bike-advocacy talk first, then an optional ride at about 10 mph for an hour and back. The time stays the same, the location and the partner shop change each month.
